content.text: {"id": "mm4949a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an estimated 27,600* (95% confidence limits [CL]=22,190--33,010) persons sought ED care"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The estimated number of injuries seen in EDs in September 2000 was nearly 18 times higher than in May 2000."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In August, September, and October 2000, the estimated number of injuries requiring ED care was 6,529"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The most common type of injury was a fracture or dislocation (29%), of which 70% were to the arm or hand."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an estimated 27,600* (95% confidence limits [CL]=22,190--33,010) persons sought ED care"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Each of the preceding 3 months also exceeded the 12-month total for either 1998 or 1999."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The estimated number of injuries seen in EDs in September 2000 was nearly 18 times higher than in May 2000."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CPSC and CDC analyzed preliminary data from CPSC's National Electronic Injury Surveillance System (NEISS)"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Injuries associated with unpowered scooters have increased dramatically since May 2000"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted according to the probability of hospital selection in the NEISS sample to provide estimates for the U.S. population"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "NEISS was used to estimate scooter-related injuries, and IPII was used to identify scooter-related deaths."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Estimates are based on the approximate range at the 95% confidence level of relative sampling error."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
